quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane. It warns you about a hazard ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop then proceed when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Stop at the marked line, crosswalk, or before the intersection. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on an upcoming hill.
There are trucks on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead. Roads cross in all four directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a side road meets the main road ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass is coming with low clearance. Do not pass if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (usually 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Slow down and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead will be divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Check for vehicles only where you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all other vehicles go first.
Stop completely. Look in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely. Look in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must stop completely. Look left, right, and left again for traffic before you proceed.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic light colors from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged from top to bottom as red, yellow, and green. Red is always on top.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may go if it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign means you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. You may have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only flows in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows you the direction traffic flows. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers of a railroad crossing ahead. Be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive slowly and watch for bikes in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, let oncoming traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, let oncoming traffic go first.
questions.explanation: This sign means that cars turning left on a green light do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before you turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a steep hill is ahead. Slow down and prepare your brakes for safe driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The tracks cross at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic is merging from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests and use paddles and flags to direct traffic through work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that you are leaving a divided highway and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge in from the right. Be ready to let them merge safely.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangle-shaped sign is a "Yield" sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Only stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed for a highway exit. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can go if the road is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not drive toward this sign. Turn around.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign alerts drivers to school zones. These signs warn that children may be present in the area.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed under all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: The speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit if conditions are bad. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you what traffic laws you must follow. This sign means you must drive in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: A driver extends their left arm and hand upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm and hand upward, they are signaling a right turn. Be ready to adjust your driving if the driver ahead is using this signal.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work correctly because one side of your car is higher.
You may damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You may hydroplane if water is on the shoulder.
You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This could cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to a winding road ahead. Slow down as needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn in the direction the arrow points. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield to trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to trains.
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare you for upcoming road conditions. This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this road sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangle with black lettering means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of a two-way road where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows the distance from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (in this case, 12 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and prepare drivers for upcoming conditions. This sign tells you a stop sign is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. This sign means U-turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and will soon drive on a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on any road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until it is safe to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: When you see a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Be alert when driving through intersections or turning, especially at school crossings.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed in this area. You must follow this traffic law.

questions.question: This sign warns that the road ahead:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve right and then curve left.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash along the highway.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road. Drive carefully and slowly through this area.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter this road or driveway from your current direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A steep downhill or hill is coming.
The road ahead will get narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: A steep downhill or hill is coming.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill or hill ahead. The road may be long, steep, or have sharp curves. Slow down.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road curves left then right.
The road curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right and then curve left. Slow down and adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: May continue through or exit from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions and dangers ahead. This sign warns that there is not much space above the road.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape mean?
questions.explanation: A diamond-shaped yellow sign warns of danger ahead. Orange diamond signs warn of dangers in or near work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead winds with curves.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery and hard to control when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers that animals, people, or bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns of a traffic signal coming up. Be ready for red, yellow, and green lights.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on this street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection. Do not make a right turn here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down when you see a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending. Cars in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs are stop signs. You must stop and check if it is safe before driving through the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement can be slippery. Slow down because your car will take longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic from another road may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: If you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Be traveling in the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Check that it is safe, then proceed. Yield to all other traffic and pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you to watch for traffic entering from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a side road crossing your path ahead. Be ready for traffic from that side road.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and crossings. Watch carefully for children and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and use your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crosswalk is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for vehicles with disability license plates or disability parking placards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign means a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this green arrow mean on a lane control signal?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you about a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle shows it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It is solid orange during the day and appears as a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange is the standard color for work zones. If you see orange signs, cones, or barrels, stay alert and be ready for changing driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead. You must follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It warns that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must drive to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions immediately ahead. This sign warns that the number of lanes is decreasing and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the median divider.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive on that road. In rain, snow, ice, or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. This sign means you cannot make U-turns where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead so you can prepare for other traffic or to turn.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point downward, they are signaling they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you are following this driver.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange is only used for construction and maintenance warning signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield when turning left on green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield when turning left on green.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on a green light. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
Certain turns are allowed from certain lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle lane. These lanes are for buses and cars with a driver and at least one passenger.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians. Then proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead shows red.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead shows green.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is joining from another road. Give extra space for drivers to merge safely.
Traffic is joining from another road. Keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is joining from another road. Give extra space for drivers to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is merging into your lane. Check your mirrors and side. Move to another lane if you can to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You may see this sign where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this red and white sign tell you to do?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep the same speed and check all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop if needed. Let vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle always means:
